svg.title: Services are background jobs: every VirtualPyTest service, grouped in server and host, in one image
svg.text: Stream, watch, record, measure: each is its own job.
Every one is named vpt-something and shown on the Status page.
One per server. The web app talks to it
A server box can also be a host: it runs both lists.
One next to your devices, in the lab or anywhere
Each host runs the ones it needs. The names are the same everywhere.
Every service is declared there, so a stopped one shows
A scheduled job is red only when its last run failed.
Deploys restart only the server, the host and the stream.
The other services need a restart by hand after a change.
Named vpt-something. Shown on the Status page.
A stopped service is seen at once, not found by a failed test.
